translations.en.sahih: By the fig and the olive
translations.en.pickthall: By the fig and the olive,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Fig and the Olive,

translations.en.pickthall: And by this land made safe;
translations.id.indonesian: dan demi kota (Mekah) ini yang aman,

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem

translations.en.sahih: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
translations.en.pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
translations.en.yusufali: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dalam bentuk yang sebaik-baiknya.

transliteration: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen

translations.en.sahih: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
translations.en.pickthall: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
translations.en.yusufali: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami kembalikan dia ke tempat yang serendah-rendahnya (neraka),

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
transliteration: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

translations.en.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
translations.en.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
translations.en.yusufali: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal saleh; maka bagi mereka pahala yang tiada putus-putusnya.

transliteration: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen

translations.en.sahih: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
translations.en.pickthall: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
translations.en.yusufali: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah yang menyebabkan kamu mendustakan (hari) pembalasan sesudah (adanya keterangan-keterangan) itu?

translations.en.sahih: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
translations.en.pickthall: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
translations.en.yusufali: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
